auditor_value: θ = 15° (sin 2θ = ½; the second root 2θ = 150°, θ = 75°, is not offered) — option (a)

findings.quote: Using the other solution of sin2θ = ½ that lies past 45°, namely 2θ = 150°, then halving it wrongly gives θ = 60°.
findings.note: Halving 150° gives 75°, not 60°; the stated cause cannot produce the number the entry names, so it does not describe a real route to option (c).
findings.fix: Mistaking ½ for the sine of 60° turns sin 2θ = ½ into 2θ = 120°, which gives θ = 60°.

notes: Solution answer 15° matches mine. Steps correct. The steps present θ = 15° as the only root of sin 2θ = ½ (75° also satisfies it), which is harmless here because only 15° is offered.
